title: Fixed normalized open-factor data and completed maps
statement: In the fixed ordinary completed-coefficient derived categories [def-sf-pull-completion-comparison], and with normalized tensor completion [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison], Open is the record of the strict augmented extension/reduction tower, completion commutation with its unique unit-compatible map, exact open restriction and extension on complete and constructible objects, fixed pullback comparison, section-normalized restriction isomorphism and Hom bijection, scalar reduction mate and intervals. gamma is the ordered completion of the ordinary open projection. theta is the fixed ordinary pullback-square compositor. OrdinaryExchange records the ordinary exchange isomorphism whose inverse is the specified open-unit transpose. beta is the ordered composite of the inverse horizontal completion comparison, completion of the ordinary exchange, open completion commutation and source completion comparison. These are the existing definitions of lem-sf-pf-open-factor-coherence extracted verbatim; no data or proof is chosen. The signatures also use [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-cbc-open-immersion-square], [def-sf-open-reduction-coefficient-mate], [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data].
